question: Among living patients whose last names begin with "A" and who each have exactly one distinct condition, which eight conditions have the highest number of different active medications prescribed to any single patient, and what are their corresponding codes?
sql:
WITH living_patients AS (
  SELECT 
    p.id as patient_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient` p
  WHERE p.deceased IS NULL
    AND (SELECT n.family FROM UNNEST(p.name) n LIMIT 1) LIKE 'A%'
),
patients_with_one_condition AS (
  SELECT lp.patient_id
  FROM living_patients lp
  WHERE (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code)
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
    WHERE c.subject.patientId = lp.patient_id
  ) = 1
),
patient_conditions AS (
  SELECT 
    pwc.patient_id,
    c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code as condition_code,
    c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].display as condition_display
  FROM patients_with_one_condition pwc
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
    ON c.subject.patientId = pwc.patient_id
),
patient_active_meds AS (
  SELECT 
    pc.patient_id,
    pc.condition_code,
    pc.condition_display,
    mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[OFFSET(0)].code as med_code
  FROM patient_conditions pc
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request` mr
    ON mr.subject.patientId = pc.patient_id
    AND mr.status = 'active'
),
med_count_per_patient_per_condition AS (
  SELECT 
    condition_code,
    condition_display,
    patient_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT med_code) as num_medications
  FROM patient_active_meds
  GROUP BY condition_code, condition_display, patient_id
),
max_meds_per_condition AS (
  SELECT 
    condition_code,
    condition_display,
    MAX(num_medications) as max_medications
  FROM med_count_per_patient_per_condition
  GROUP BY condition_code, condition_display
)
SELECT 
  condition_display as condition_name,
  condition_code,
  max_medications
FROM max_meds_per_condition
ORDER BY max_medications DESC, condition_code ASC
LIMIT 8
